_doc: Vei's final test (MECHANICS 6, GAMEPLAY 3d), read by VeiFronts (scripts/raid/vei_fronts.gd). Placeholders until calibrated. fronts_required of the four fronts must clear. fronts.<id>: have = per_stat * sum(stat of big undead counted on the front) + per_backlog * backlog + per_q * digest_q; need = need_base + need_per_pool * Vei's living pool; cleared = have >= need. phase1: ref_s = seconds to clear a front at have == need; max_rate caps have/need; phase1_max_s is the timeout (lost). raise_have_per_mult: what one raised undead adds to a front's have in phase 1, per stat_mult. ferry (phase 2): base + per_pool*living_pool + per_uncleared*uncleared (mass/s), divided by (1 + per_q_div*(q-1)). mote_mass = value of one raised mote toward the raise rate; raise_ema_beats = smoothing window of the raise rate in tempo beats. Vei breaks after break_beats consecutive beats with raise > ferry. loss_backlog_keep = share of the backlog kept on a loss.
